concept.title: Release milestones
concept.shortdesc: Every release on the Releases page is a milestone on the plan, drawn as a filled diamond at the release's target date. Its name, date and status are the release's: change them on the Releases page, which Open the release leads to.

conbody.p: A release milestone starts with two criteria: every requirement in the release approved, and every one verified, which is what the Releases page calls ready. Edit criteria sets its own, and Reset to defaults puts those two back. Its requirement criteria count only the requirements in that release. A release marked Released is met.
